source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent old farm windmill progressing from pale graphite geometry to a finished graphite and restrained steel-blue, rust-red, and ochre colored-pencil sketch.
source.notes: Keep one tall American farm windpump in a slight three-quarter view with one circular rotor, exactly twelve broad blades, one center hub, one tail vane, one tapered four-legged lattice tower, visible cross braces, a low grass line, and one broken shadow. No barn, silo, livestock, text, logo, extra windmill, or final-only detail is allowed.

process_strategy: Lock the tapered tower, pale rotor circle, hub, tail axis, and ground footprint first; build the tower, gearbox, and tail while leaving the rotor circle erasably light; divide that guide into twelve faint spokes before widening those divisions into individual blades and adding the lattice braces; then shade and color only established metal and wood so the final stays geometrically cumulative.

final_elements.name: tower, rotor, hub, tail, and ground guides
final_elements.description: One pale tapered tower trapezoid with four leg axes, a large rotor circle, centered hub, tail-arm axis and vane reserve, horizontal ground line, low grass-cluster reserves, and a broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: tower, gearbox, tail, and twelve rotor divisions
final_elements.description: The center hub, rear tail arm and vane, narrow top gearbox, and four tapered tower legs in keeper lines, with the rotor circumference still pale and exactly twelve faint radial divisions mapped from the hub.

final_elements.name: twelve rotor blades and lattice bracing
final_elements.description: Exactly twelve separate broad blade wedges widened around the faint radial divisions, with short outer blade edges instead of one dark empty circle, plus clear X-braces between the established tower legs.

final_elements.name: windmill hardware, grass, and broken shadow
final_elements.description: A small hub cap, short gearbox seams, tail-arm joints, tower foot plates, a low uneven grass line, several small grass tufts, and one broken cast shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite modeling and restrained farm color
final_elements.description: Soft graphite planes, steel-blue pencil on the established rotor and tower, rust-red pencil on the tail vane and hub cap, warm ochre grass, darker joint accents, and preserved paper highlights.

rejection_checks: The same tower taper, pale rotor guide, hub position, tail angle, crop, scale, viewpoint, and four-leg footprint must persist through all six panels.

Panel 2 must not harden the rotor guide into a dark continuous circle; it must keep that circle erasably pale and divide it into exactly twelve faint spokes that lead directly to the blade wedges in panel 3.
Exactly twelve broad rotor blades, the lattice braces, tail vane, hardware, grass, color areas, paper highlights, and broken shadow must appear before the final panel and persist through the finish.
No barn, silo, fence, livestock, extra windmill, weather vane figure, text, number, logo, decorative background, or final-only motif may appear.
No adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size, and the finish must remain a believable 20-30 minute handmade sketch rather than polished architectural illustration.
